about.desc: Our goal is to simplify your path through our international consultancy: softlanding, legal, financial, tax, foreign trade and audit services.
about.heading: SIMPLIFYING THE PROCESSES...

mision.title: Mission
mision.text: To provide comprehensive solutions in accounting, tax and legal advisory, as well as foreign trade and auditing — all under one roof. We position ourselves as a strategic partner that fully adapts to each client's needs at every stage of their growth. We facilitate the connection between Mexican and foreign corporate cultures, deeply understanding the challenges and requirements of each company. Our priority is to offer expert, personalized guidance, ensuring regulatory compliance, process optimization and the sustained success of our clients in a globalized environment.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be a leading company in all the areas we cover, standing out professionally, technically and personally, valuing each of our team members and ensuring their wellbeing. We aspire to be an example to follow.

valores.title: Values
valores.text: At SAETA we are professionals by excellence. We always strive to improve individually and as a team in order to deliver premium quality work. We never forget our human values: respect, trust, punctuality, humility, honesty, transparency and above all, empathy.

unete.title: Join Us
unete.text: We are looking for committed talent. If you want to be part of a company in constant international growth, check our openings on LinkedIn.

services.heading: Our services
services.sub: We simplify your company's corporate processes. Explore each service area and discover the detail.

cta.title: Do you need a customized service?
cta.sub: We adapt to your company, industry and specific objectives.

categories.title: Financial Services
categories.desc: Accounting, controlling, invoicing, financial risks and tax to keep your finances clear and compliant.

items.title: Invoicing
points: Generation of customized invoices with client, product, service and price information
Ensuring invoices comply with local tax regulations
Electronic delivery of invoices to clients via email or platforms

items.title: Tax
points: Clarification of SAT requirements and internal audits, tax refund requests for favorable balances, transfer pricing
All of the above for both individuals and legal entities

categories.title: Payroll & Treasury
categories.desc: End-to-end payroll and treasury management: onboarding, payroll calculation, taxes, IMSS, ISN, payments and online banking.

items.title: Employee onboarding and offboarding
points: Complete process of adding or removing employees from the company payroll

items.title: Salary modifications
points: Increase or decrease of an employee's salary according to company specifications

items.title: Payroll calculation
points: Complete process of calculating employee salaries and deductions according to general regulations

items.title: Severance and settlements
points: Complete process of calculating and paying the amount due to an employee who retires or is dismissed

items.title: Risk premium calculation
points: Complete process of calculating employee salaries and deductions to generate payroll

items.title: Tax calculation
points: Calculation of the corresponding taxes payable on employee salaries

items.title: IMSS (Mexican Social Security Institute)
points: Registration and calculation of the company's obligations before the IMSS

items.title: ISN (Payroll Tax)
points: Payroll tax that employers must pay based on the total remuneration granted to their employees

items.title: Treasury
points: Monitoring and forecasting of cash inflows and outflows to ensure the company has sufficient liquidity
Generation of periodic reports showing the financial position and cash flows

items.title: Payments
points: Review and scheduling of payments to suppliers

items.title: Online banking
points: Operation of all online banking systems along with the services and products they manage
Joint tokens to provide greater security in resource management

categories.title: Foreign Trade
categories.desc: IMMEX, NOMs and permits, Data Stage audit, fixed-asset control, customs consulting and logistics process.

items.title: Compliance with Mexican Official Standards (NOMs), COFEPRIS and SEDENA permits
Audit through DATA STAGE
points: Validation of recent and past operations
Preparation of documentation for VAT refunds
Verification of information in specific annexes (Annex 24 and Annex 30)

items.title: Audit and diagnosis in fixed-asset control
Advisory and consulting on customs, tax and foreign trade matters
Logistics process
points: Coordination with logistics providers, including transport and customs services
Supervision of shipments throughout the delivery process

categories.title: Legal Services
categories.desc: Corporate, labor, civil and commercial, immigration and intellectual property law to protect your company.

items.title: Corporate Law
points: Registration of permanent establishments and/or representative offices
Registration before the Ministry of Finance for ISN payment

items.title: Labor Law
points: Benefits management: vouchers, insurance, savings funds, payroll cards

items.title: Civil and Commercial Law
points: Drafting of contracts: service provision, purchase-sale, assignment and lease

items.title: Immigration
points: Application for entry and exit permits
Notice of any change in the foreigner's and/or company's situation

items.title: Intellectual Property
points: Resolution of disputes over improper trademark use
